input: 19 ClinVar records on chromosome 21 (public ClinVar identifiers; INFO dropped) chosen from an AlphaMissense run over the whole chromosome, plus one two-allele record at a position none of them holds, each of its alleles a row of the prediction file, and one substitution written with an unchanged leading base (the alleles both engines trim before the match): missense substitutions every transcript row of which the prediction's amino-acid change names, records of several transcripts whose prediction names one of them (the other rows unscored under transcript_match), records whose transcripts give different amino-acid changes, a missense substitution the file has no row for, a synonymous, a stop-gained, a frameshift and an intronic record the plugin leaves alone, and a reverse-strand gene; every predicted transcript carries a one-digit version, so both engines match it under transcript_match

alphamissense.tsv.gz.generator: plugin_data/alphamissense.tsv.gz: the published file cut with tabix to every record's span plus 10 bases on each side (regions merged), the header lines kept, bgzip-compressed and indexed with tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2, the columns the published preparation indexes; the rows carry the file's values unchanged
alphamissense.tsv.gz.source: AlphaMissense_hg38.tsv.gz as published by Google DeepMind, indexed with tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2; the predictions are licensed CC BY 4.0 by the publisher's README, and the file's own header comment reads CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as published

generator: plugin_data/alphamissense.tsv.gz: a tabix cut of the published AlphaMissense file to the records' spans (plugin_fixtures); json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --dir-plugins <VEP_plugins checkout> for the manifest's run, and one Ensembl VEP 116.3 container run per format for each flag set from the vep command recorded under its flag_sets entry, the corpus mounted read-only at /work/corpus as the working directory and the AlphaMissense plugin read from the container's plugin directory, whose module text equals the VEP_plugins release/116 checkout's; manifest: tools/vep-golden-corpus select --include for every record, flag-set, then classify for the manifest's run and each flag set against the committed tree's binary
